verdict.rationale: Airwallex explicitly supports bulk operations via its Batch Transfers API (create multiple transfers to multiple beneficiaries/countries/currencies at once for payroll/supplier runs), plus programmatic account creation at scale, card issuing at scale, and API/CLI/SDK access enabling automation of many items programmatically. missing for 10: no explicit documentation of bulk operations for other resource types (e.g., bulk card issuance or bulk expense retrieval) beyond transfers, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of batch limits or performance at scale.
